spec_theorems.name: run_valid_shape
spec_theorems.informal: For the supported -c invocation, the output is the input line list mapped through the character-range transformation and the exit code is zero.

spec_theorems.name: run_preserves_line_count
spec_theorems.informal: The utility emits exactly one output line for every input line.

spec_theorems.name: cutSpec_length_bound
spec_theorems.informal: Selecting a closed character range cannot produce a line longer than its input line.

spec_theorems.name: cutSpec_content_preserved
spec_theorems.informal: Every character appearing in a selected output line also appeared in the corresponding input line.

spec_theorems.name: run_exit_code_on_valid_input
spec_theorems.informal: A supported -c invocation over stdin returns exit status zero.
